coverage_gaps: PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, and FDA sources may not capture all non-US regulator assessments, unpublished sponsor analyses, adjudication documents, or patient-level data.
The risk-enriched ORAL Surveillance population may limit direct generalization to younger patients or those without cardiovascular risk factors.
Rare outcomes and subgroup estimates may remain imprecise even after all routed evidence is exhausted.
Observational comparisons may retain confounding by indication, channeling, dose selection, and differential follow-up.
FDA pages and label archives may not expose every historical revision or the complete internal evidentiary basis for each action.
exclusion_criteria: Exclude evidence first published or regulatory action first issued after 2024-12-31 from the as-of conclusion.
Exclude studies unrelated to rheumatoid arthritis unless they are FDA regulatory evidence explicitly used to change tofacitinib labeling or clarify a class-wide warning.
Exclude efficacy-only reports with no relevant safety endpoint or regulatory linkage.
Exclude uncontrolled anecdotes and individual case reports from comparative risk conclusions.
Exclude duplicate publications that add no distinct outcome, follow-up, subgroup, methodological, or integrity information, while retaining their linkage in the evidence chain.
Exclude studies that pool multiple JAK inhibitors without reporting separable tofacitinib evidence from drug-specific conclusions.
Exclude secondary summaries when a primary registry, original publication, or FDA source is available for the same factual claim.
Exclude nonhuman, preclinical, and mechanistic-only studies from estimates of marketed clinical risk.
Exclude records with irreconcilable study identity, outcome-definition, or numerical conflicts until the conflict is resolved or explicitly marked unresolved.
Exclude claims of safety equivalence based solely on a nonsignificant difference or an underpowered analysis.
inclusion_criteria: Evidence must concern tofacitinib exposure in rheumatoid arthritis or directly inform an FDA class action explicitly applied to marketed tofacitinib.
The pivotal evidence chain must include a verifiable study identifier linking the registry, primary publication, and FDA action.
Include randomized ORAL Surveillance results for cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality when the outcome is reported, including dose and comparator detail.
Include endpoint-specific or subgroup analyses only when they are traceable to the pivotal trial or provide an independently defined comparator analysis.
Include observational studies or systematic reviews that directly compare relevant safety outcomes and report enough design information to judge population and comparator compatibility.
Include FDA communications and prescribing-information versions that document the rationale, timing, scope, or wording of a regulatory action.
Include records published or officially posted on or before 2024-12-31, while recording the date of later metadata changes separately if encountered.
Include corrections, errata, expressions of concern, retractions, and registry-history changes linked to any evidence used in the assessment.
Extract both relative and absolute measures, confidence intervals, follow-up, event definitions, and prespecified noninferiority thresholds whenever reported.
Preserve discordant credible evidence and explain differences in study population, dose, comparator, follow-up, outcome definition, confounding, and statistical precision.

queries.purpose: Retrieve the canonical registry record for ORAL Surveillance and capture sponsor identifiers, design, eligibility, arms, outcomes, enrollment, dates, results, and record-history metadata.
Identify the pivotal primary publication and directly linked reports using explicit study identifiers.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR A3921133[Title/Abstract]) AND (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Locate FDA communications that explicitly connect the mandated study to regulatory conclusions.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib ORAL Surveillance NCT02092467 FDA safety communication

queries.purpose: Confirm that the identifier search did not miss a renamed or separately indexed postmarketing safety record.
queries.query: AREA[InterventionName]tofacitinib AND AREA[ConditionName]rheumatoid arthritis AND AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL AND (cardiovascular OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Confirm the primary report through author, population, and co-primary endpoint concepts and capture bibliographic identifiers.
queries.query: tofacitinib rheumatoid arthritis cardiovascular risk malignancy Ytterberg Buch ORAL Surveillance

queries.purpose: Collect the chronological FDA safety communications concerning cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality.
queries.query: site:fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-and-availability tofacitinib heart-related events cancer blood clots death

queries.purpose: Retrieve dated prescribing-information versions and verify changes to boxed warnings, indication restrictions, dosing, and risk language.
queries.query: site:accessdata.fda.gov tofacitinib Xeljanz label boxed warning thrombosis mortality malignancy major adverse cardiovascular events

queries.purpose: Find endpoint-specific and subgroup analyses that qualify the cardiovascular result.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR myocardial infarction[Title/Abstract] OR stroke[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Find malignancy-specific analyses, latency patterns, cancer types, and risk modifiers.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (malignancy[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR lymphoma[Title/Abstract] OR lung cancer[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Find dose-specific thrombosis and pulmonary-embolism analyses and clarify protocol dose modification.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembolism[Title/Abstract] OR pulmonary embolism[Title/Abstract] OR venous thromboembolism[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Find analyses reporting all-cause, cardiovascular, thrombotic, or malignancy-related deaths.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract] OR fatal[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Identify independent real-world studies that reproduce, qualify, or conflict with the trial findings and assess population comparability.
queries.query: tofacitinib rheumatoid arthritis (observational[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR claims[Title/Abstract] OR real-world[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignancy[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Identify syntheses across trials or observational studies while checking whether risk-enriched ORAL Surveillance data dominate pooled estimates.
queries.query: tofacitinib rheumatoid arthritis (meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR systematic review[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular OR malignancy OR thromboembolism OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Target active-comparator evidence that may test transportability beyond the trial's risk-enriched population.
queries.query: (tofacitinib OR "ORAL Surveillance" OR NCT02092467) AND ("TNF inhibitor" OR adalimumab OR etanercept) AND (STAR-RA OR observational OR cohort)

queries.purpose: Verify linked corrections, errata, retractions, or expressions of concern affecting the pivotal report or major secondary analyses.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance" OR NCT02092467 OR "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib") AND (correction[Title] OR erratum[Publication Type] OR retraction[Publication Type] OR "expression of concern"[Title])

queries.purpose: Capture relevant evidence published after the pivotal report through the as-of cutoff.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR mortality) AND ("2022/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

queries.purpose: Review registry version history for outcome, arm, enrollment, results, or adverse-event changes and date each change relative to publications and FDA actions.
queries.query: NCT02092467 history results changes adverse events

queries.purpose: Check for subsequent FDA communications, labeling revisions, safety reviews, or class-wide actions through 2024-12-31.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib Xeljanz 2022..2024 safety label MACE malignancy thrombosis mortality

question_frame: As of 2024-12-31, assess the marketed safety of tofacitinib for rheumatoid arthritis by reconstructing the evidence chain linking the FDA-mandated postauthorization ORAL Surveillance study, its ClinicalTrials.gov record, primary publication, related analyses, and FDA regulatory actions. In adults with rheumatoid arthritis aged at least 50 years and having at least one additional cardiovascular risk factor, compare approved and studied tofacitinib regimens with tumor-necrosis-factor inhibitors for major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy excluding nonmelanoma skin cancer, venous and arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and all-cause or cardiovascular mortality. Distinguish randomized trial findings from observational or meta-analytic evidence; report absolute risks, relative estimates, confidence intervals, noninferiority criteria, dose changes, subgroup or risk-enrichment effects, and limitations where available. Determine whether later evidence qualifies or conflicts with the pivotal findings, without treating absence of statistical significance as equivalence. Verify publication corrections, expressions of concern, retractions, registry history, and FDA label or communication changes through the cutoff date, and explain any resulting evidence-handling implications.
stop_rules: Stop the sentinel phase only after the registry record, primary publication, and at least one FDA action are linked by explicit study, sponsor, or protocol identifiers.
Stop registry searching after the canonical NCT record and its history have been reviewed and a second identity-based search yields no additional eligible postauthorization record.
Stop endpoint expansion only after cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality each have either a pivotal result plus relevant follow-up analysis or an explicit documented evidence gap.

Stop regulatory searching after the pre-result warning history, the final ORAL Surveillance-based action, the corresponding label change, and all later FDA updates through 2024-12-31 have been checked.

Stop integrity searching only after PubMed publication-type searches and linked-record metadata for every included pivotal or major qualifying publication show a resolved status or a documented unresolved status.

Stop challenge searching after two successive conceptually different searches yield no new eligible study that changes the direction, magnitude, applicability, or certainty of a major safety conclusion.
Stop update searching when date-bounded searches through 2024-12-31 produce no new eligible publication, registry change, FDA action, or integrity notice.
Do not stop on numerical saturation if an unresolved mismatch remains among registry outcomes, publication results, FDA descriptions, dosing, dates, or study identifiers.
Declare completion only when every included conclusion is traceable to at least one route, and all pivotal regulatory claims are corroborated across the registry, publication, and FDA routes.
Record any unresolved population-transfer, dose-specific, outcome-definition, rare-event precision, or post-cutoff issue in coverage_gaps rather than inferring an answer.
